# ui::PickFileOptions

Header: `winui/ui/Pickers.hpp`.

What [pick_file()](namespace-ui.md#pick_file) and [pick_files()](namespace-ui.md#pick_files) are asked for. Every field is optional.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> file_name;
if (auto path = ui::pick_file(window, {.title      = "Pick an image",
                                       .file_types = {{.name = "Images", .extensions = {".png", ".jpg"}}}}))
{
    file_name = ui::path_to_utf8(path->filename());
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The dialog caption; empty keeps the default. |
| `commit_button_text` | `std::string` |  | The Open button's label; empty keeps "Open". |
| `file_types` | `std::vector<FileType>` |  | Named types for the type box. They win over `extensions`. |
| `extensions` | `std::vector<std::string>` |  | Plain extensions (".txt", or "*"), one type-box entry each, plus one for all of them and one for all files. Used when `file_types` is empty. |
| `initial_file_type` | `std::optional<std::size_t>` |  | Which type-box entry starts selected, zero-based. Unset (the default) selects the first named type, or with `extensions` the entry for all of them. |
| `start_location` | `PickerLocation` | `PickerLocation::Unspecified` | The known folder to open in when `folder` is empty. |
| `folder` | `std::filesystem::path` |  | The folder to open in, if it exists; absolute. Wins over `start_location`. |
| `remember_last` | `bool` | `true` | True: `folder` (or `start_location`) opens the first time, and after that the dialog reopens wherever the user last picked from. False: it opens every time. |
